50 gram gold bar – Secondary Market:
Secondary market 50 gram gold bars are susceptible to slight damage, tear, or even dents. This is the reason why these secondary market gold bars are often available at lower premiums. These gold bars cannot be guaranteed to be in perfect condition, however, they are tested for gold content, purity, and weight. They are tested to be .9999 pure gold and weigh 50 grams.
Main Highlights of 50 Gram Gold Bar – Secondary Market:
Contains 50 grams of .9999 pure gold.
Each of the gold bars comes in protective packages.
The obverse depends on the bar you receive.
The reverse depends on the bar you receive.
Tested for the gold purity, content, and weight.
Secondary Market Condition.
These bars may or may not come with an assayer’s certificate.
